decision: The user asked on 2026-11-02 for a photo on every dish ("find or generate photos for the dishes; every dish must have a photo"), the same decision as Logan Corner on 2026-10-27.
how: Uploaded through the owner admin in the user's Chrome (media upload plus dish update, one publication per dish), publication 34 -> 59. restaurant.json is unchanged, so a --replace re-import would remove these photos.
image: Commons original downloaded, cropped/resized to 1000x600 JPEG (sharp, mozjpeg q84); the uploaded bytes are the local files listed here.
labelling: Each dish description ends with "Illustrative photo, not from this restaurant." plus " Photo: <author>, <licence>." when the licence requires attribution; alt text is "<what it shows>, illustrative photo".
kept: Own photos kept unchanged: Samosa, Cha Cha, Kik Alecha, Veggie Combo, Kokeb Mix, Canned Soda (355 ml).
liveCheck: publicationVersion 59; 31 of 31 dishes have a photo; all 93 public media URLs return 200; a Kokeb media URL on the Alfy host returns 404; names and prices unchanged; Logan Corner 144, Juvian's 20, omni-rest (Alfy's) 22 unchanged.
notUsed: Rejected: Tex-Mex jalapeno poppers and Indian besan-stuffed chillies for Siening Kariya (different dish), Kitfo (Ethiopian Tartar) plated as a fine-dining tower, curry rice from a Japanese restaurant named Ethiopia, branded water bottles.
